upgrade_desc_1: We're reinventing the school. Orbis reads behavior, not just grades — it discovers when a student drifts, and which subject makes their mind come alive. Then it builds a unique learning report: this is what they need to study, and this is how they understand best.
upgrade_desc_2: An AI assistant that answers instantly, analyzes, and guides. Smart scheduling that organizes operations with precision. No wasted time, no missed opportunity.
upgrade_desc_3: Intelligent cameras that watch over safety and alert before danger happens. Live interaction with the school environment, as if the building itself breathes with its students.
upgrade_desc_4: We build tools that don't just manage schools — they change the future of every student inside them. This is the Mulverse promise: education that leaves no one behind.
upgrade_feature_1: An AI assistant that knows your students before you ask
upgrade_feature_2: Smart scheduling that organizes operations with precision
upgrade_feature_3: Reports that tell you what a student needs before they fall behind
upgrade_feature_4: Smart monitoring that alerts before the risk
upgrade_feature_5: Seamless integration with everything you have, making it better
upgrade_feature_more: And continuous development of tools that change the game...
